title: Plate with a hole (Kirsch)
sentence: A quarter-symmetry model of a plate with a circular hole, two graded mapped blocks meeting at the hole.
theory: For an infinite plate in uniaxial tension $\sigma$, Kirsch gives $\sigma_{\theta\theta}(a,\theta) = \sigma\left(1 - 2\cos 2\theta\right)$ on the hole edge: $K_t = 3$ across the hole and $-\sigma$ at its poles. Only a quarter is modelled; the two cut planes are symmetry planes, where the normal displacement is zero and the shear traction vanishes.
